BYOK — Bring your own key

You control your
API keys. Always.

Agentivity doesn't provide or mark up LLM tokens. Connect your own key — and pay your provider directly. Compatible with any OpenAI-compatible provider, not just Anthropic and OpenAI.

Your data

Your prompts, your outputs, your agent configurations never touch our infrastructure. Everything stays between you and your LLM provider.

Your costs

We don't sit between you and the token. No markup, no mystery fees. You know exactly what you spend — because you pay the provider directly.

Your control

Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including local models. Switch providers, rotate keys, set limits — no permission needed.

A word on our licence.

Agentivity is source-available under the Agentivity Sustainable Use Licence. The code is public and auditable. Free for personal and internal commercial use.

One limit: you can't use it to build a competing platform. That's it.

Common questions

Is the Free plan really free?
Yes. Open source, self-hosted, no time limit. You need Docker and your own API key. That's it. No credit card, no trial period, no "free tier" with artificial caps.
What's Docker?
A tool that runs Agentivity on your machine or server in one command. Full guide in the docs →
Do I need an API key?
Yes — for all plans. You connect your own key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or any compatible provider. We never touch your tokens or mark up your usage. How to get an API key →
When do the cloud plans launch?
We're working on it. Join the waitlist below — you'll be notified first and get access to launch pricing before it goes public.
Can I use Agentivity as a white-label platform for my clients?
Yes — the Enterprise plan includes white-label options. You build on Agentivity, deliver under your brand. Contact us →
What's the difference between Free and Enterprise?
Free is self-hosted, community-supported, and requires Docker. Enterprise adds SSO, audit logs, on-premise options, white-label, SLA, and dedicated support — designed for organisations with compliance and governance requirements.
